pattern_explanation: Both languages borrowed these words from the same Latin roots, so the spellings stayed close. Over time their meanings drifted apart, so the lookalike English word is not a reliable translation.
false_friend_warning: Each Portuguese word looks almost identical to an English word, but the meanings differ: the Portuguese words mean to intend, to watch, current and occasional. Translating them literally into the English lookalikes leads to serious errors.
